# EvDrawer

> A panel that slides in from the right, left or bottom over a scrim - traps focus, closes on Escape, and restores focus on close.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:drawer` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvDrawer } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvDrawer>` or `<ev-drawer>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/drawer/EvDrawer.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<div class="ev-drawer__panel">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvDrawer
  title="Detail vendor"
  subtext="PT Contoh Sejahtera"
>
  Isi drawer.
</EvDrawer>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Drawer**, frame `4258:76893` (Drawer). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Show contextual details, forms, or settings without leaving the page — filters, record details, create / edit flows. Right drawer on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile.

### When not to use

- For critical confirmations → use Alert Dialog (`evoq-ui:alert-dialog`). For full, complex workflows → use a dedicated page. Don't stack multiple drawers on top of each other.

### Do

- Match the platform — D- right drawer on desktop, M- bottom sheet on mobile. Keep a clear title, a close affordance, and footer actions. Use Wide only when content needs it.

### Don't

- Don't hide the close affordance. Don't overload a drawer with unrelated content. Don't make the drawer wider than the content needs.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvDrawer`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<div class="ev-drawer__panel">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:drawer` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
